title: ever FAUN|See-Through Floor Length Lace Chiffon Evening Dress with Half Sleeve
descriptionHtml:
When the occasion calls for a chic and elegant look, go in for this flowing see-through lace evening dress. The sophistication of this evening dress is amplified because of its lace bodice and sleeves. The evening dress is uniquely complemented with a figure-flattering wide ribbon waistband that accentuates the waistline. The romantically designed V-shaped back guarantees a look that will make heads turn upon your arrival at any party, wedding or even your prom.


More Colors: Purple Orchid \ Burgundy \ Blush \ Grey \ White \ Navy Blue \ Black \ Dusty Blue


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Closure: It is Concealed Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Padded Enough For No Bra Option, with Lining.


Fabric: Shell:100%Polyester   
Lining:100%Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is Low Stretch.
